entry_points.text: Sleepable runner executes array; extrema derive from intervals; spill recovery checks window and role mask.
Trampoline key packs object and type ids with no-target bit; slot scales negative offset; frame resolves index or callsite.

exports.text: Program lookup by fd, type, path or id and conditional get fail as unsupported; typeless lookup delegates to driver-aware form with binding off.
When mediation is disabled, capability and storage queries report absent, validation and range and locked mutation report unsupported, and errno propagation reports true.
Unified kernel/user pointer offers space test, constructors for each space, null test and advance within active space.

hazards.text: Failed probe copy zeroes dest; speculation guards need barriers; internal bug warns once and logs.
ABI: iter reschedule is bit 0, max 2 ctx args; poke has nop/call/jump; bprintf limits 12 args, 1024 text, 512 binary.
ABI: var off/size cap 2^29, string 320, insn text 32, reg 8/half 4, 128 stack slots, 16 frames, sanitize bits and mask.
ABI: at most 64 maps, 64 BTF objects, 256 subprograms; temp log staging 1024 bytes.
ABI: kfunc attribute bits cover acquire, release, null return, sleepable, destructive, RCU, iter trio, protection, fastcall, arena trio, implicit args, spinlock safety and perfmon.

invariants.text: Tracing access allows only aligned reads inside arg area; typed access applies those checks then BTF validation.
Unprivileged enablement and current-context presence each have enabled and always-negative configurations.
NUMA follows attr only with flag, net capability needs admin caps, and kernel probe copy falls back to failure.
Only four map kinds are per-CPU; op flags reject unknown bits, bad lock use, stray CPU selectors and bad CPUs.
Type helpers isolate modifiers and classify mem, BTF id, map, packet and socket pointers plus nullability and fault risk.
Map pointer and key helpers expose poison, unprivileged and seen marks and return immediates with reserved bits cleared.
Socket context validation denies and conversion yields zero; read-only dynptr from skb reports unsupported.
External single-read, privilege, guard, CPU, memcg, migration and bit helpers are referenced by identity only.

locks.text: Array walk holds migration disabled throughout and read guard only around non-sleepable entries.
Verifier records ordinary, preempt-disabled and RCU depths plus active irq and lock identities with source.

state_machines.text: Null array succeeds; empty slots and recursion misses skip; results combine by conjunction with per-item cookies.
Iterators go active to drained terminal; paths use remainder with fork, revisit loop hints and complexity ceiling.

structs.text: Iterator registration holds target, handlers, sizes and arg helpers; meta holds seq refs and counters; map-elem ctx holds map plus key/value.
Key wrapper pairs key with held flag; storage blob holds RCU-protected local storage pointer.
Crypto type descriptor holds lifecycle, keying, cipher and size operations plus owner and short name.
Register knowledge pairs kind tag with intervals, linkage, ancestry and precision; payload is kind-selected.
Frames hold regs and tagged spill slots; exploration holds frames, branches, counters, coverage and jump log.
Index collection is count plus flexible slots; per-insn record holds position, markers, component id, liveness and const cache.
Verifier context holds positions, program, work stack, state tables, maps, BTF refs, log window and subprogram data.
Kfunc descriptor holds model, ids and address; table is count plus array ordered by identity during verification.
BSG buffer holds length and scatter list; job holds linkage, refcount, timeout, buffers, result and private data.
